title: A counter shared by threads
description:
Show a race condition, then fix it two ways.

```
unsafe:  31842 (should be 40000)
synchronized: 40000
AtomicInteger: 40000
pool results: [1, 4, 9, 16, 25]
```
hints: `Thread t = new Thread(() -> { for (int i = 0; i < 10_000; i++) body.run(); });`, kept in a list so you can `join` each one (lesson 6.04).
`pool.submit(() -> n * n)` returns a `Future<Integer>`; `future.get()` waits for it. Shut the pool down at the end.
requirements: Four threads each add 1 to a counter 10,000 times; start them and `join` them.
Show that a plain `int` field loses updates, then fix it with `synchronized` and with `AtomicInteger`.
Use an `ExecutorService` with `Future`s to square 1 to 5 and collect the results in order.
stretch: Replace the futures with `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync` and combine them with `allOf`.
